title: LLMs are Biased Teachers: Evaluating LLM Bias in Personalized Education
findings: Significant biases were observed for the Religion subgroup across models and tasks. When considering Maximum Difference Bias (MDB), which measures the largest gap in treatment within a group, the Religion subgroup showed very high bias. For the generative task, LLMs exhibited varied bias patterns: Llama showed stereotype bias, while GPT-4o and Gemini showed mixed biases for the Religion subgroup. An example of overpersonalization in generated content included presenting a plumbing explanation from a 'Christian perspective' for a Christian student.

The benchmark measured this bias through ranking tasks (selecting appropriate difficulty levels) and generation tasks (creating educational content).
